source.method: Reuse byte-identical F124-AH source generator and admission with newly rebound seeds; restore original graph after admission; then symmetrically transform source keys of both labels by a new independently fixed invertible 16-bit map. New public role prefix opaque task nonce reveals no operator family. Attach public input/output demonstration pairs generated ONLY from unrelated seed namespace, same for pos and neg, never derived from their graph keys.
source.notes: Heldout consists of new transformation STRUCTURES, not just parameter values. Both phases have public demonstration examples; HOLDOUT cannot fit using hidden labels or previous heldout tasks.
source.demo_sampling: Deterministic pseudorandom 16-bit public input values from namespace F124AJ|lane|period|seed|vector|family|demo_index (not graph key), corresponding output generated by rule; same demos in positive and negative graphs. No exact oracle-path examples.
source.public_query: Original graph structure fields plus demos and opaque rel_task_SHA role tags. No operator names/masks in public strings; source evaluator knows family ONLY to validate truth after prediction.
source.admission: Reference valid positive=1 negative=0 under inverse transformed source-only evaluator, prior literal raw-key equality positive=0, same token multiset/topology between paired graphs, labels never supplied to predictor.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: A shared, relation-agnostic bit-coordinate correspondence learner can infer a 16-bit bit-permutation plus XOR flip pattern from in-task unlabeled input-output demonstrations, and reuse that induced transformation on 13–15 hop heldout semantics without hard-coded per-operator decoding.
Yggdrasil.model: Infer correspondence for every output bit by matching demonstration input bit columns or their complement. Solve one-to-one mapping deterministically, fail closed on ambiguity. Inverse-normalize ONLY public edge source keys before original F124-AG 7-active/9-retained transition eta=.1 unchanged. No rule-string interpretation, no oracle, no test-label learning. Inductive bias *restricted* to permutation plus XOR masks, explicitly stated.
Yggdrasil.selection: Maximum paired accuracy on new TRAIN 48 pairs using original AG eta=.1, tie fewest demonstration pairs. Freeze chosen demo count before first HOLDOUT; inference-time examples supplied per new HOLDOUT task are unlabeled public support, NOT HOLDOUT labels.
Yggdrasil.limits: This is a learned mapping from in-task demonstrations with engineered permutation/XOR inductive bias, not independent discovery of an unconstrained causal operation.

Wingless.hypothesis: With demo-induced operator normalizing the graph, the original one packed-state model still loses positive evidence on long chains; separate source-blind per-hop trace from scorer-only original true paths to determine lost-candidate, lost-retained-proxy and threshold failure without changing state.
Wingless.model: Use same TRAIN-selected demo count shared from Ygg, same public demonstration learner. Apply inferred transformation to source keys, run immutable original one-state 12bit packed engine max 64 one packed state per node, no new retained flags, confidence fields, cache or fingerprint.
